title: Triassic–Jurassic extinction
description: Mass extinction ending the Triassic period
extract: The Triassic–Jurassic (Tr-J) extinction event, often called the Triassic–Jurassic mass extinction (TJME) or end-Triassic extinction, marks the boundary between the Triassic and Jurassic periods, 201.4 million years ago. It represents one of five major extinction events during the Phanerozoic, profoundly affecting life on land and in the oceans.
